headlines.title: Netflix Wipes Out Five Years of Gains
headlines.summary: Netflix shares have erased five years of gains, falling 53% from their June 2025 peak as slowing engagement, YouTube competition and a costly content strategy test investor patience.

headlines.title: Clarion Partners’ loan on Netflix-occupied Hollywood campus hits market
headlines.summary: Clarion’s David Gilbert and 817-827 Vine Street in Hollywood (Clarion, Google Maps)Clarion Partners’ lender is shopping the note on a Netflix-occupied creative office campus in Tinseltown, The Real Deal has learned. Cushman & Wakefield marketing materials viewed by TRD note the loan is on the campus at 817-827 Vine Street in Hollywood, which is completely leased to Netflix until 2031. AXA Equitable Life Insurance lent Clarion Partners $48 million in December 2019, records reveal.

headlines.title: Netflix (NFLX) Stock May Be a ‘Loser’ This Year, But You Can Still Scalp Profits From It
headlines.summary: Eventually, a recovery for NFLX stock will likely come. In the meantime, you may consider a temporary bear spread.

headlines.title: Ramit Sethi Says There's Only So Much You Can Cut From Your Budget, But No Limit To What You Can Earn. An Extra $1K A Month Is A $12K Raise
headlines.summary: Giving up your daily coffee, canceling Netflix and cooking every meal at home might save you a few hundred dollars a month, says personal finance author Ramit Sethi.

headlines.title: Netflix trades at under 18x earnings after a steep valuation reset
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Netflix Inc (NFLX) closed at $63.26 on Nov 10, 2026 (3:59 PM EST), with pre-market near $62.91. The market cap is about $259.77B. The stock is down 44.33% over one year and 32.80% year to date. Its 52-week range is $61.39 to $116.73, so it trades near the bottom.

description: Netflix, Inc. provides entertainment services worldwide. The company offers television (TV) series, documentaries, feature films, games, and live programming across various genres and languages. It also provides members the ability to receive streaming content through a host of internet-connected devices, including TVs, digital video players, TV set-top boxes, and mobile devices. Netflix, Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Los Gatos, California.
